title: Bake-off (validators): z-ai/glm-5.3-flash
question: Who stands behind NEAR’s validators? Make me a fresh flower with their backers, not an existing one.
note: A real run on NEAR AI Cloud (T060), kept with its signatures.

conflicts: Governance power in NEAR sits in the House of Stake (veNEAR voting power), which this flower does not draw
Raw token holdings in unstaked wallets are a third kind of power, separate from epoch stake
This flower draws epoch stake and its delegator backing, not the other two
inferred: Grouping delegations under 1,000 NEAR into per-pool, per-class rows preserves each pool's total but hides which specific small account backs it
That all pool participants from the factory list plus RPC validators/proposals/kickouts is a complete picture of active validator pools

mappings.why: Wider edge for a larger share of epoch stake, compressed to a 2x band so the first dozen validators stay legible
Taller bar for a larger stake share, on a square-root scale so the tail is visible
Named validators (self-declared name in pool-details.near or a named account id) versus anonymous pools
Solid for self-declared or verified names, dashed for inferred, none for unknown, so the reader sees identity strength at a glance
The question: each validator's edge splits into who stands behind it — other delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts, and lockups
Largest stake first, clockwise from the top, to lead with the biggest validators

power_means.claim: Power in this flower is a validator's share of NEAR mainnet stake for the current epoch: stake-weighted seat and block-production weight. The 371 included validators held 593,372,642.81 NEAR; the top 10 held 36.25%, and 9 validators reached a one-third blocking threshold (Nakamoto coefficient at 33.34%).
Backing is unevenly spread but not captured: HHI 0.021471 and Gini 0.836217 over validators; the tail of 311 validators holds 13.80% of stake.

interpretation.summary: A fresh flower of NEAR mainnet validators as of 2026-11-03 (block 222,915,356): 60 sides, one per validator, largest epoch stake first. Each edge splits into the backers standing behind that pool — other delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts and lockups. Top 10 validators hold 36.25% of 593.4M NEAR epoch stake and 9 validators reach a one-third threshold.
unknowns: Liquid-staking contracts (Meta Pool, LiNEAR, ...) back pools as delegators, but their own token holders are not listed, so who ultimately stands behind that segment is unknown
Lockup contract owners (*.lockup.near) were not resolved, so lockup backing is not attributed to people
424 idle pools (~6,656 tiny delegation records) were not crawled, so a few pools' backers are missing or partial
Pool identities are self-declared in pool-details.near via NearBlocks; none are verified here
Addresses are not people: named pools and delegator accounts are on-chain identities, not confirmed humans or companies
Delegations under 1,000 NEAR are folded into per-pool, per-class group rows, so individual small backers below that line are not visible

turns.content:
- **Flower**: [/draft?flower=e39996053b39dc32](/draft?flower=e39996053b39dc32)
- **What you'll see**: 60 validator petals, largest first, each edge split into its backers — other delegators, accounts with 1M+ NEAR, liquid-staking contracts, lockups. Top 10 hold 36.25% of 593.4M NEAR epoch stake; 9 reach a one-third threshold.
- **Mapping** (as of 2026-11-03, block 222,915,356):
  - `segments` → the four backer classes per pool (`fastnear-rpc-staking-pool-views`, `fastnear-rpc-liquid-staking`)
  - `width`/`height` → stake share, band/root scaled (`fastnear-rpc-validators`)
  - `colour`/`outline` → named vs anonymous, self-declared vs unknown (`nearblocks-validators`)
- **Changed from the default**: `colour: identity`, `segments: backers`.
- **What this can't tell you**: liquid-staking token holders (Meta Pool, LiNEAR holders not listed); lockup owners unresolved; 424 idle pools uncrawled; sub-1,000-NEAR delegators folded per pool; identities self-declared, addresses ≠ people.

Governance power (House of Stake veNEAR voting) is a different flower — ask if you want that drawn.
